description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5365015212630 SPACER,SLEEVE: Line 0001 Qty 276 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0099 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
